verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Authenticator can add TOTP-based accounts (including non-Microsoft services) and generate offline one-time codes (docs-20, docs-12, docs-2), implying QR-based setup is supported, but hands-on community reports describe a known, unfixed bug where scanning the QR code fails and users must manually enter the secret instead (comm-3), directly contradicting the 'scan and immediately generate codes' claim for some accounts. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the exact QR-scan-to-TOTP flow, and resolution/acknowledgment of the reported scanning bug.
